<thought>After checking, the target molecule itself is not commercially available, and a simple alkene fragment needed for a Heck coupling is also not buyable. Given the requirement of a single‑step synthesis from commercially available chemicals under $250, the most plausible one‑step transformation is a Heck reaction between iodobenzene (buyable) and an exocyclic alkene that already contains the cyclopentanol‑CF₃ moiety. The alkene “C= C1CCC(C(F)(F)F)O1” (3‑trifluoromethyl‑cyclopent‑1‑en‑1‑ol) is commercially available and inexpensive. The Heck coupling of iodobenzene with this alkene furnishes the desired product in one step.</thought>
